mapper.insert: insert into t_ai_chat_session (enterprise_id, user_id, title, create_time, update_time) values (#{enterpriseId}, #{userId}, #{title}, sysdate(), sysdate())
mapper.select: select session_id, enterprise_id, user_id, title, create_time, update_time from t_ai_chat_session where enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} and session_id = #{sessionId} and del_flag = '0'

select s.session_id, s.enterprise_id, s.user_id, s.title, s.create_time, s.update_time, (select count(1) from t_ai_chat_message m where m.session_id = s.session_id) as message_count from t_ai_chat_session s where s.enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} and s.user_id = #{userId} and s.del_flag = '0' order by s.update_time desc limit #{limit}
mapper.insert: insert into t_ai_chat_message (enterprise_id, session_id, role, content, sources, model, token_usage, cost_ms, create_time) values (#{enterpriseId}, #{sessionId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{sources}, #{model}, #{tokenUsage}, #{costMs}, sysdate())
